shortcutDescription: Give this project a Home Screen icon and open it with a tap.
shortcutIconHint: Choose a photo or image file. Images are cropped to a square.
shortcutStepLinkBody: We’ll prepare your app and copy its launch link.
shortcutStepCreateBody: Add the “Open URLs” action in Shortcuts. Paste the copied link into its URL field and name the shortcut.
shortcutStepHomeBody: Export the icon below and choose “Save to Files”. In Shortcuts, open Details → Add to Home Screen. Select Image (or tap the icon) → Choose File, select the saved image, set the name, then tap Add.
shortcutRequested: Request sent. Confirm Add in the system prompt to place the icon on your Home Screen.
shortcutUpdated: Your existing Home Screen shortcut has been updated.
shortcutUnsupported: Adding Home Screen shortcuts is unavailable in this version of RunWhale or with your current launcher.
shortcutDeviceOnly: Open this project in RunWhale on your phone to add it to the Home Screen.
shortcutSharingUnavailable: Image sharing is unavailable on this device.
shortcutRuntimeNote: Opens your latest successful preview. Keep RunWhale and this project on your device. App features that use the internet still need a connection.
shortcutMissingProject: This shortcut’s project is no longer on this device. You can remove the icon from your Home Screen.
fileDraftKept: This edit is kept as a Studio draft.
fileDraftDescription: Agent and Preview use the saved file. Apply saves the text shown below; discard keeps the saved file.
aboutSettingsSummary: App version, build number, and source code.
sourceLinkFailed: Could not open GitHub. Please try again.
continueWorkingProjectLoadFailed: Could not load your recent project.
continueWorkingNoSession: Open this project to start a session.
continueWorkingSessionUnavailable: Session details are unavailable. You can still open the project.
localPersistenceFailedBody: RunWhale could not save the latest local changes on this device. {message}
localPersistenceUnknownError: Device storage reported an unknown error.
workspaceEmptyDescription: Create a Web or Expo project, or import an existing repository to begin.
projectLoadFailedDescription: Your saved projects couldn’t be read. Try loading them again.
customModelSettingsDescription: Override the provider endpoint and the models RunWhale can use.
invalidBaseUrl: Enter a complete HTTP or HTTPS base URL, or leave it blank to use the provider default.
duplicateModelId: Model IDs must be unique within this provider.
invalidModelCapacity: Context window and max output tokens must be positive whole numbers when provided.
credentialLoadFailed: Could not load the saved API key from secure storage. Try again.
credentialSecureStorageRequired: API keys require secure device storage, which is unavailable in the browser.
removeApiKeyConfirmationBody: RunWhale will delete this API key from secure storage and stop using it in the local runtime.
credentialSaveFailed: Could not save the API key to secure storage. Check this app's secure-storage access, then try again.
credentialActivationFailed: The API key is saved on this device, but the local runtime could not use it yet. Try saving again when Runtime is ready.
credentialSyncWarning: Some saved credentials could not be synchronized with the local runtime. Runtime remains available; open Settings and save the affected credential again.
credentialRemoveFailed: Could not remove the API key from secure storage. Try again.
credentialDeactivationFailed: The API key was removed from secure storage, but the local runtime could not clear its in-memory copy. Restart Runtime before continuing.
agentCredentialRequiredBody: Add a {provider} API key in Settings before running the Agent.
runtimeEnvironmentLoadFailed: RunWhale could not load package details from the local runtime. Try again.
runtimeReportedFailure: The local runtime reported a problem. Restart it and try again.
generalSettingsDescription: Choose Agent permissions, language, appearance, and how messages are handled.
modelsSettingsDescription: Choose a provider and model, and securely manage its API key.
agentPresetsSettingsDescription: Set the default Agent behavior for new sessions.
pluginsSettingsDescription: See the mobile tool profile available to the Agent.
runtimeSettingsDescription: Check the embedded Node.js toolchain used to run local Agent tasks.
sshSettingsSummary: Device key for GitHub SSH access.
sshSettingsDescription: Manage the device key used to access GitHub repositories over SSH.
reviewPermissionDescription: Ask before write-capable Agent actions. File reads, diagnostics, Git inspection, and Preview do not need approval.
readOnlyPermissionDescription: Allow file reads, diagnostics, Git inspection, and Preview. Block file writes, Node/TypeScript tasks, dependency installs, Git changes, and automatic commits.
fullAccessPermissionDescription: Run write-capable actions, including validated npm dependency installs, without per-action approval. In project sessions, file tools can access RunWhale’s app container; operating-system, credential, and Preview boundaries remain.
fullAccessConfirmationBody: The Agent can modify any file available to RunWhale and install validated npm registry dependencies without asking. Install scripts stay disabled; the operating-system sandbox, credentials, and Preview boundaries remain protected.
standardPresetDescription: Use the default Agent behavior for general coding tasks.
minimalPresetDescription: Prefer concise responses, the fewest necessary tools, and the smallest verified change. Tool access is unchanged.
busyFollowupDescription: Queue the message for the Agent after its current turn.
busySteerDescription: Send the message into the current turn so the Agent can adjust course.
pluginDescription: RunWhale currently uses a fixed mobile profile with controlled local tools. Additional plugins are not available in this build.
webTemplateDescription: React website with full-screen Web Preview.
projectTemplateNote: Creates a runnable starter project. Preview is determined by the selected template.
repositoryPreviewNote: The imported project determines Preview from runwhale.json.
projectCreationInProgressBody: RunWhale is still preparing the project and its first Agent session. Keep this screen open until it finishes.
projectHasNoFiles: This project has no files yet.
selectFileToEdit: Select a file to start editing.
sessionHistoryLoadFailed: Could not restore this session history. Try again.
askAgent: Describe what you want to build
previewAgentNotified: The error has been shared with Agent.
packageApprovalDescription: RunWhale will use embedded npm with scripts disabled, then verify integrity and scan the installed files.
questionNoLongerPending: This question is no longer waiting for an answer. Refresh the session and try again.
sessionsLoadFailed: Could not load saved sessions. Try again.
deleteProjectConfirmation: This permanently deletes this device's project files, Git history, all sessions, attachments, dependencies, project caches, and generated project data. It cannot be undone. Remote Git repositories and original imported files are not affected.
deleteProjectActionDescription: Delete this project and all of its local data.
deleteProjectBusy: Resolve or reject any pending dependency request, or stop the running Agent, Node task, or dependency install for this project, then try again.
deleteProjectFailed: Could not finish deleting the project: {message}
openProjectHint: Opens the project and its latest session.
renameProjectDescription: Change the project name without changing its files, directory, or Git history.
projectNameTooLong: Use a project name of 80 characters or fewer.
projectNameInvalid: Project names cannot contain slashes, backslashes, control characters, or only dots.
deleteSessionConfirmation: “{title}” and its transcript will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
sessionNoMessages: This session has no visible messages yet.
codeCopyFailed: Could not copy this code. Try again.
responseCopyFailed: Could not copy this response. Try again.
sessionRecoveryUnavailable: The session could not be loaded. Please retry when the runtime is connected.
sessionRetryPromptMissing: The last message is unavailable. Send a new message to continue.
sessionPausedBody: Progress saved. If the session does not resume when you return, tap Continue.
agentBackgroundWaiting: Progress saved · Open RunWhale to continue
sessionFailedBody: The agent could not finish this request. Retry to continue.
sessionCredentialFailureBody: The provider could not authenticate this request. Check its API key and endpoint in Settings, or select another provider, then retry.
sessionStoppedBody: The agent stopped before finishing. Retry to continue.
sessionInterruptedBody: The session was interrupted before finishing. Retry to continue.
agentConnectionInterrupted: Connection interrupted. The agent may still be running. Refresh the session to check its status before sending again.
queueAnotherMessage: Add the next message while Agent is busy…
queueNoLongerPending: This message is no longer pending.
deleteQueuedMessageConfirmationBody: This removes the message before the Agent can use it. This cannot be undone.
sshRuntimeRequired: The local runtime must be ready before you can generate or rotate a Git SSH key.
sshSecureStorageRequired: Git SSH key generation and rotation require secure device storage, which is unavailable here.
sshSecureStorageAccessFailed: RunWhale could not access secure device storage. Try again.
rotateSshKeyConfirmationBody: This replaces the current key. Repositories and services using its public key will stop authenticating until you add the new public key.
sshKeyLoadFailed: Could not load the saved SSH key details. Try again.
sshPrivateKeyMissing: The saved private key is missing. This public key can no longer authenticate; rotate it and replace the key on GitHub.
sshKeyGenerationFailed: Could not generate or save the SSH key. Try again.
sshKeyCopyFailed: Could not copy the public key. Try again.
discardApiKeyDraftConfirmationBody: Switching from {currentProvider} to {nextProvider} will discard the API key you entered.
sessionLogDescription: Full history, tool activity, and attachments
sessionLogDownloadFailed: Could not export the log. Please try again.
sessionInstructionsDescription: Full instructions used in the latest request
backgroundResumedDetail: The session resumed after a pause and is continuing the unfinished request.

unsupportedImage: Choose a PNG, JPEG, WebP, or GIF image.
imageTooLarge: Each image must be 5 MB or smaller.
imageCacheUnavailable: The selected image is not available in the application cache. Choose it again.
cameraPermissionDenied: Allow camera access to take a photo for this message.
githubImportExternalCodeWarning: This is external code. Review the source and only import content you trust.
githubImportSafetyBody: A new local project will be created. RunWhale will not overwrite a project, install dependencies, run Agent, or start Preview.
shareProjectDescription: Share the current GitHub commit without uploading project contents to RunWhale.
sharePushNotice: RunWhale never commits automatically, changes repository visibility, or force-pushes. If needed, this action performs one non-force push.
sharePushRequiredDescription: The remote branch is behind this commit. Creating the link will push once without force.
sharePrivacyNotice: The link reveals the GitHub owner, repository name, and commit SHA. Private repository access remains controlled by GitHub.
runtimeStartupFailedBody: Try starting the local runtime again.
